purpose: Select an Arabic TrOCR checkpoint (the TrOCR authors released none). Screened on the first 10 golden samples; a candidate needed to be within reach of EasyOCR (0.2332 corpus CER on golden and dev) to justify a full run.

screened.failure_mode: real words, none correct (Tunisian place names)

did not run: NotImplementedError 'Cannot copy out of meta tensor; no data!' on every image. An earlier version of this file recorded this as 'empty output, CER 1.00', which was the harness scoring ten failures, not a recognition result.

decision: NEGATIVE RESULT: of four community TrOCR checkpoints, three ran and none read a word correctly on a ten-image screen (CER 0.71 to 0.89 against EasyOCR's 0.23); the fourth could not be run. TrOCR engine remains implemented (models/trocr.py) but is not part of the evaluated configuration. In-domain fine-tuning was out of scope.

also_rejected_without_screening.reason: dialectal target, out of MSA scope

run_files: results/trocr_screen_<owner>_<name>.json, produced by moocr.harness.evaluate --engine trocr --split golden --max-samples 10
